weights._note: Mirrors the Bangalore flagship-v0 model: a curated set of named MMR water bodies scored by status severity + cultural prominence + size + narrative weight, normalised to 0-100 (critical>=84, high 60-83, moderate 42-59, low<42). No census-condition or automated WQ join yet; status_severity is hand-set from sourced reporting. Will refine when MPCB lake WQ + the restoration-projects pipeline land.

notes: Curated flagship set across the 9 MMR corporations (BMC Powai/Vihar/Tulsi/Bandra/Banganga; Thane Siddheshwar/Upvan/Kacharali/Masunda/Kavesar/Makhmali; Kalyan Kala Talao; Panvel Ballaleshwar; Navi Mumbai DPS/NRI wetlands). Bodies that are not distinct OSM water polygons (Masunda, Kavesar, the Navi Mumbai tidal wetlands, Makhmali) carry osm_id=null and render as orphan priority circles at an approximate centroid. The recurring theme is cosmetic beautification substituting for water-quality restoration; Powai and the CIDCO-contested flamingo wetlands carry the highest narrative weight.

water_bodies.name: Powai Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Drinking source lost to sewage: ~18 MLD inflow (BMC affidavit ~10.9), eutrophic, hyacinth (23-25% per BMC Apr-2024 ops vs 80% in the Jul-2025 NGT framing); NGT OA 150/2025, ~Rs 66 cr STP not live until Dec 2027; still hosts wild mugger crocodiles beside IIT Bombay.

water_bodies.name: Siddheshwar Talao
water_bodies.rationale: A priceless Thane temple tank (a 9th-c Brahma idol was found during cleaning) left to rot - slum sewage on three sides, hyacinth, fish kills, shrinking to encroachment - and pointedly EXCLUDED from the City-of-Lakes conservation list. The counter-narrative to the beautified showcase lakes.

water_bodies.name: Kala Talao
water_bodies.rationale: Kalyan's Adil Shah-era tank, 'beautified' with a track, boating and fountain yet still acidic (pH 3.9-4.25), sewage-fed and eutrophic - the clearest beautified-but-not-restored paradox in the outer MMR.

water_bodies.name: DPS Flamingo Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Seawoods tidal wetland declared a Conservation Reserve (Apr 2025) - then targeted by a CIDCO de-reservation resolution days later; flamingo deaths in 2024 after a water-flow disruption, return in 2025 after partial tidal restoration. The flagship citizen-vs-CIDCO wetland fight.

water_bodies.name: Vadale Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Old Panvel's temple lake by the Ballaleshwar shrine: a Rs 13 cr beautification (2021), Phase-2 boating cancelled on ecological grounds (2024), now nature-based weed control (>1 lakh Salvinia weevils with ICAR-DWR, 2026-27). The outer MMR's cleanest restoration arc.

water_bodies.name: Banganga Talao
water_bodies.rationale: Ancient sacred tank at Malabar Hill; a Sept-2025 Bombay HC order refused idol immersion here ('right to clean water prevails'), an immersion-pollution precedent for heritage tanks across the state.

water_bodies.name: Makhmali Talao
water_bodies.rationale: Thane's 'velvet lake' - poor water quality, a non-functional aerator and food-dumping, left out of the AMRUT-2 funding list; subject of the citizen 'Majha Talao' awareness campaign. The neighbourhood-tank gap behind the flagship lakes.

water_bodies.name: Masunda Lake
water_bodies.rationale: The emotional and civic centre of 'City of Lakes' Thane (glass pathway, island Shiva temple), but with greenish water, foul odour and blocked inlets reported; area est. (reduced ~1/3 by 1950s station road). Not a distinct OSM water polygon.

water_bodies.name: Vihar Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Mumbai's largest in-city lake and the headwater impoundment of the Mithi - the river behind the 2005 flood. SGNP-protected, supplies ~3% of the city; restoration leverage is catchment + Mithi-source protection, not the lake body itself.

water_bodies.name: Upvan Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Thane's flagship public-realm lake and festival venue (Sanskruti arts fest); a frequently-cited example of hardscape 'beautification' applied to a living water body.

water_bodies.name: Bandra Talao
water_bodies.rationale: Grade-II heritage tank, ~200 years old, dewatered May 2026 for a ~Rs 20 cr BMC restoration (15th Finance Commission) - the test case for reviving Mumbai's small heritage talaos as blue-green assets.

water_bodies.name: NRI Wetland
water_bodies.rationale: The original Navi Mumbai 'golf course vs flamingos' battle: Bombay HC struck down the golf course (2018, total ban on NWIA-wetland reclamation), the developer's SLP is still pending in the Supreme Court, and a recommended Conservation Reserve status is undeclared.

water_bodies.name: Kavesar Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Thane's last natural wetland (200+ species, the district's only naturally-growing white lotus) inside Hiranandani Estate; a ~Rs 6-7 cr TMC 'beautification' is opposed by the Save Kavesar Lake movement (8,000+ signatures) who argue it would destroy the ecology. Governance-not-water in one lake.

water_bodies.name: Kacharali Lake
water_bodies.rationale: Showcase lake beside Thane's municipal HQ; beautified/well-maintained and on the AMRUT-2 list - included as the maintained-flagship reference within the City of Lakes.

water_bodies.name: Tulsi Lake
water_bodies.rationale: The forest-buffered, encroachment-free counterpoint to Powai inside SGNP; commonly cited as the cleanest of Mumbai's reservoirs (qualitative). Low restoration pressure - included as the healthy reference.
